subject: SIG evidence sprint: Nimbus Health penetration artifacts & remediation owners

From: Nina Alvarez <nina.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security-team@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG - request for pen test artifacts and remediation owners

Hi Jonas,

We are finalizing the SIG questionnaire intake for our upcoming vendor review and the reviewer has asked for the penetration test report and supporting artifacts for Redwood Inference (last 12 months). Specifically they asked for:

- Final pen-test report (PDF)
- Evidence of remediation for high/critical findings (patch dates, PR links or tickets)
- Asset/host inventory mapping for the target scope referenced in the report
- Contact for follow-up technical clarifications during the review window (Dec 6-10)

Can you confirm whether you can bundle these and share by EOD Dec 2? We can accept a password-protected ZIP via shared Drive link. Also please indicate the engineers/owners who can field follow-ups during the review window.

Attachments: nimbus-sig-pt-request.pdf (request form)

Thanks,
Nina Alvarez
Vendor Risk Manager | Nimbus Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: nina.alvarez@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG - request for pen test artifacts and remediation owners

Monica / Rishi — forwarding an inbound SIG evidence request from Nimbus Health (see attached request). They need the penetration report + evidence of remediation and owners available Dec 6-10. Can we do a quick evidence sweep and bundle by EOD Dec 2?

Proposed split:
- Monica: gather final PT report and inventory mapping; produce a simple CSV that maps findings to assets and ticket IDs (example column: finding_id, asset, ticket, status, remediation_date)
- Rishi: collect remediation evidence for high/critical fixes (PR links, hotfix notes, deploy timestamps) and confirm owners for follow-up calls

If either of you need additional time, call it out now — Nimbus is expecting delivery by EOD tomorrow. I can take the final packaging and upload to a password-protected Drive folder.

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
